name: How much does it cost to install new flooring in a rental unit?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install new flooring in a rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of flooring installation in a rental unit varies widely depending on the material chosen, the size of the area, and the complexity of the installation. Luxury vinyl plank typically ranges from $3 to $7 per square foot for materials and installation. Laminate can be slightly less, from $2 to $6 per square foot. Carpet averages $2 to $5 per square foot. These figures are estimates and can fluctuate based on specific product quality and labor rates in the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on material, area size, and installation complexity. LVP typically ranges from $3-$7 per square foot, laminate $2-$6, and carpet $2-$5, including materials and installation.
